verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Confirmed upcoming 10th edition: 13–16 July 2027, Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland, in La Côte/Nyon territory. verifyPrev.venueText: Announced at Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon. Unnamed pre-reserved hotel rooms advertised with 31 March 2027 booking deadline; contracts and remaining supply unverified.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: NO_NAMED_COMMERCIAL_CONTACT_WITH_SOURCE remains unresolved. No individual was verified as organizer, meetings coordinator or accommodation buyer for the specific 2027 edition. The verified edition-specific contact is the institutional mailbox info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch; it is not a named person.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Switzerland. The Agroscope announcement publication date of 5 October 2026 is not an event date.
findings.venueCommitments: Announced venue: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. This is an announced research-site venue, not evidence of a hotel contract.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official event website advertises pre-reserved hotel rooms with a booking deadline of 31 March 2027. Hotel identities, allocation size, remaining availability and authority to add another hotel are unverified. Do not interpret the deadline as an open hotel-supplier tender.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is explicitly identified as the organizer of the 2027 edition. No individual hotel-contracting authority or external PCO is identified in the reviewed edition-specific official pages.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Pre-reserved hotel rooms are already advertised. No sourced overflow requirement, incumbent hotel names or uncommitted room demand was established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch requesting the name and role of the person coordinating GDPM 2027 accommodation and confirmation whether additional La Côte/Founex hotel options are accepted. Establish incumbent hotels, remaining demand and transport requirements before proposing YOTEL Geneva Lake; do not claim an available room block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 accommodation sales accessibility is unconfirmed. A published general-inquiries mailbox offers a routing path, not evidence that additional hotel proposals are accepted.

supportingSources.claim: Official GDPM 2027 homepage: Agroscope organizer; 13–16 July 2027; Changins Aula venue; generic event mailbox; pre-reserved hotel booking deadline of 31 March 2027.
Official Agroscope event calendar confirms organizer, Nyon venue address and event dates; no named person is identified in the retrieved listing.
Agroscope announcement published 5 October 2026 confirms the workshop takes place 13–16 July 2027.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Ask the official GDPM 2027 mailbox, info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch, to identify the accommodation coordinator by name and role and confirm whether additional hotel proposals are welcome.
remainingUncertainties: No named commercially relevant person with a verified role for GDPM 2027 was found; the requested contact gap remains unresolved.
Hotel identities, allocation quantities, remaining demand and the person authorized to consider additional hotels remain unverified.
structured.commercialOpportunityTrack: Named-contact verification unresolved; accommodation sourcing unconfirmed.
